prompt:
CONCEPT: the personification of Steel — the lord of the Steel House of the Iron Nation. A female character who IS that substance; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the substance’s traits, within the element’s own palette. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
ELEMENT TRAITS of Iron (Fe) to carry in her design and the scene: dark grey iron with bright steel highlights, orange-brown rust and glowing forge-orange heat, magnetism (iron filings, lodestone), hardness and weight, the smell of a smithy; it is the element of tools, weapons, bridges, machines and blood. Palette: iron grey, steel silver, rust orange, ember red, black soot.
HOUSE TRAITS of Steel: polished mirror-bright steel, straight hard lines, tempered blue-grey edges, rivets and girders; the strong, dependable side of iron. Palette: brushed steel silver, tempered blue, graphite black, a single ember-orange accent.
AGE: in her twenties — smooth youthful skin, soft full cheeks; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases) and a soft smile that never creases her face.
SILHOUETTE: athletic build; a bob; brushed-steel silver hair with a tempered-blue sheen.
FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): diamond-shaped face; deep-set eyes; thick straight brows; straight narrow nose; thin long lips; steel-blue eyes.
WORLD — STEAMPUNK: the Industrial Revolution around 1860: a cast-iron railway bridge over a river, a steam locomotive with a glowing firebox, blast furnaces and chimneys, riveted iron girders, gauges and valves, coal smoke under a copper sunset. COSTUME (steampunk): late-Victorian industrial dress — a high-necked blouse with a waistcoat or a tailored tail coat, leather gloves, a work apron or utility belt with brass fittings, goggles on the brow or a small instrument as ornament; below, a short bustle skirt over riding trousers and laced boots; muted palette with the traits above as accents. No armor plates, no cape, no crown unless CONCEPT says she wears one; steam, pipes and gauges in the scene; no modern plastic, no sci-fi. LIGHT: hazy gaslight and a smoky overcast sky, unless TIME & WEATHER says otherwise.
SETTING (this card): a riveting workshop with girders, chains and gas lamps.
STYLE: High-end stylized game CGI with coherent three-dimensional anatomy, physically convincing costume and prop construction, clean materials and dramatic production lighting. Preserve a designed character-art finish rather than live-action texture.
EXPOSURE (bold): the high collar unbuttoned down to the sternum with natural cleavage, sleeves rolled above the elbow, a short bustle skirt showing the legs above laced boots; the waistcoat stays buttoned at the waist. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; no corset; keep the costume WORLD describes, material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no living creature, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
source: 생성기 조립 그대로 — 철나라 판타지·스팀펑크 다시 뽑기(2026-10-31): 세계마다 옷 뼈대·과감 노출·빛, 세계마다 머리·얼굴형·눈. 가문주는 가문마다 장면 변주
